items.textToSpeech: Manganese contributes to: normal energy-yielding metabolism, the maintenance of normal bones, the normal formation of connective tissue, and the protection of cells from oxidative stress.

The European Commission has authorised these claims for products which contain at least 300 micrograms of manganese per 100 grams, per 100 millilitres or per package, if the package contains only a single portion. Is there anything else I can help you with?
